fields.label: Read-only mode
fields.help: Blocks collection/core, document, schema, commit, and optimize writes.

config.label: Solr query
config.emptyText: Run a Solr JSON query to see documents.

actions.label: Commit
actions.confirmText: Commit pending updates for this collection or core?

actions.label: Optimize
actions.confirmText: Optimize this collection or core now?

actions.label: Delete
actions.confirmText: Delete this collection or unload this core with its index data?

actions.label: Delete by query
actions.confirmText: Delete all Solr documents matching this query?

actions.label: Add field
actions.confirmText: Add this field to the managed schema?

actions.label: Edit field
actions.confirmText: Replace this field's definition? Solr requires the full definition and reindexing may be needed for existing documents.

actions.label: Delete field
actions.confirmText: Delete this field from the managed schema?
